REQ-1.description: Households (generic groups): create, rename, archive and unarchive; several per device, with the last one used reopened

REQ-2.description: Members: add, rename, mark as left with the date and rejoin; a member who left keeps their history and still appears in past expenses

REQ-3.description: Quick expense: description, date, amount, category, payer and a split equally, by shares, by exact amounts or by percentages among chosen members, exact to the cent

REQ-4.description: Itemised expense: M1's bill splitter, fed by M2's receipt reader, saved to a household with its items, assignments and receipt summary, and editable later

REQ-5.description: Someone paid on behalf of others: the payer can be any member, including one who is not part of the split

REQ-6.description: History: a list per household, newest first, filtered by member and category, with a search

REQ-7.description: Corrections: edit or delete any expense; shares and totals are derived from the stored expenses, never stored

REQ-8.description: Local persistence: IndexedDB with a versioned schema and tested migrations, saved on every change, the split draft kept and saveable into the new model

REQ-9.description: Duplicate-receipt warning: the same fiscal QR document, or the same merchant, date and total, already saved in the household

REQ-10.description: Every new screen in English and European Portuguese, on the design system, at every width from 360 px, keyboard and screen-reader usable

REQ-11.description: Completion: a household with 4 members, 30+ expenses of both kinds, a member who leaves and one who joins and several corrections survives a reload and an app update (a migration test); the split rules are unit-tested with M1's exactness guarantees

REQ-12.description: Documentation: ADR 0005 (the local data store), DESIGN.md, READMEs, the roadmap and the design canvas updated
